spec.name: Furniture Record Shelf
spec.description: A compact dark-oak record cabinet with short inset feet, an aubergine drawer panel, a small brass pull, and six individually colored vinyl sleeves in divided open storage. Front faces negative Z; all geometry fits within one block with a 0.25-unit outer margin.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: dark record cabinet with vinyl sleeves and purple inset panel. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
